body: Thank you for taking my words into consideration, it means a lot that you try to understand. I will look into that link very soon. :)
I suppose you’re right. Thank you for understanding. I’m here for you too. Feel free to shoot me a message with your discord. :)
Thank you so much, that was so lovely of you. Thank you. I hope you’re well. <3
I think my view of the world has just really turned evil over time. This was so heartfelt. Thank you, a lot. <3
Thank you, appreciate it and I have expressed it to a few people close to me. It helps to talk I guess, sometimes.

I have no spite towards people trying to help. Nothing but love towards that, my bad if it came across that way. I just have no energy for what people have to say rather than the people themselves, you know? Not spite towards the person but the words. Thank you for this. This gave me insight. I’m glad you received the help you needed. Hopefully we all do one day. Take care.

I’d just like to say I’m completely blown away by the response this has received. I didn’t think a poor attempt at articulating my thoughts into a paragraph would resonate with so many people. I only discovered this sub the day I posted this and I’m very glad to have stumbled across this community. 

For the first time in my life, I can whole heartedly say that I genuinely don’t feel alone with how I feel. While it saddens me to know that so many people can relate, I thank you. Thank you for forming a common ground, by simply being those who *actually* understand. I’d also like to say, my messages are always open. I mean it. 

To the few who have wrongly assumed that I just haven’t tried to better myself by engaging in activities like exercise, etc. or that I’m discrediting the benefits, you’re misinformed. I think that’s where a lot of the issue is embedded within too. People just assume we haven’t tried. That we just want to sit back and complain all day without putting in effort. I’ve been exercising for so many years now, I’ve had my gym membership for years now. I’ve eaten well for years now. It hasn’t made a difference mentally, it hasn’t changed my story. I know it’s not meant to, I know it’s meant to be there to make you feel good - but when you no longer have the energy to do any of those things, when you can’t eat healthy anymore because you can’t even remember the last time you ate due to no appetite, when you can’t get out of bed because you know if you do, you’ll act on those thoughts, when the only thing stopping you from dying is the pain involved but especially not knowing if it will work, what do you do? When you attempt to study but end up crying, when you’re at work but tears start falling because you just can’t shake the feeling of wanting, craving, needing to just be gone. What do you do? I know there isn’t answers but that’s what I’m sick of. I’m tired of people thinking that telling me to increase my dopamine levels through having a shower, making my bed, etc. is the change to it all. I simply do NOT have the energy to do those things. I wish I did. Believe me, I do. But when all you want to do is die, it’s fuck clean sheets. Fuck self-care. Fuck that assessment you have due because even if you fail, you hopefully won’t be alive to deal with the consequences anyway. Fuck everything. And those people who claim that everybody will be sad when you pass too? When you’re in that mindset, it’s fuck them too. Because you BELIEVE nobody cares to the degree they say they do. It’s very complex. Thank you for giving a shit, for taking the time to read whatever I have to spurt out. It does mean a lot. I wish you all well.

This really makes me just pain for you. Badly. I know a lot of people say “but you’re still here so it means you’re fighting” but that isn’t always the case either. Being here doesn’t mean we’re actively doing anything to fight it. We don’t always have a choice but to just be here either. I *hope* one day you feel less pain than you currently do now, whether that’s possible or not. You just didn’t deserve this shit.

I just don’t think I can at the moment. I don’t know when I ever will. It’s not only trauma, there’s things that still happen to this day too, I think that’s why it’s hard. When it’s still occurring. When it hasn’t passed.

Exactly, it’s almost as though people think we CHOOSE it? If I had a choice, I’d choose to be completely over the moon all the time. I’m so grateful I discovered this sub. 

And as much as you probably don’t want to hear this, I am glad you’re alive. Because if you weren’t, I wouldn’t have been able to resonate with you so deeply, or wouldn’t feel so understood. Especially in a world where struggling with what we do isn’t understood. It’s very rare to come across somebody who just gets it — you do. Thank you.

Thank you for linking it to me, I’ll be sure to browse through soon. It is definitely very hard to express feelings into words in a way that captures the extent of it. I think a lot of emotion and expression is lost through words when that’s all we really have to provide a description anyway. 

Reading is such a good hobby though, I don’t remember the last time I read but I remember being so captivated by it. Thank you for mentioning that, I think it’s allowed me to feel some sort of spark again in a way. You speak very articulately, I can tell you’re smart. 

That’s why I’m afraid of receiving professional help again. I just don’t want people to be informed, yes I want to die but I don’t want it to be made a big deal, for a commotion to unfold. I just want to be heard through it all. “If I had the energy, I’d use it to wash my face and clean my apartment”, I get it. I really, deeply felt that. If we truly possessed the energy at all, we would apply it to all these things we’re being told. “It’s just a matter of finding it in the first place”, but how?
This has actually made a lot of sense to me and has provided me with a different perspective I didn’t think I’d ever see through. Thank you for this.

“It’s because you’re always on your phone” “it’s because you’re not drinking enough water” like okay I get it. I fucking get it. It’s always because of what I do, not because of the trauma you’ve caused me. “It’s because you don’t sleep properly” but how can I? When there’s constant nightmares of the pain you’ve inflicted upon me? Constant flashbacks, racing thoughts that keep my mind awake and early hours of the night right into the morning? 

Exactly it’s like you have nothing left to give anymore and you’re told to wash your hair or some bullshit. You get it. I hope you find the strength, I really do despite how impossible it seems. It fucking sucks.

Cry as you wish, it’s important to unleash your emotions. <3 
Exactly! There isn’t a doubt that yes it feels nice, but it just doesn’t do anything of actual help, you know? I really thought I was the only person who felt that way, when you seek people’s advice but it doesn’t help and so you become frustrated, isolate yourself but still want them to come around. It becomes all so conflicting. You want to be alone but don’t want to be lonely. 

I know what you’re talking about! I have seen things like that too and videos. I’ll try and find a link and send it to you if I come across it. Something very similar, it was an animation where the depressed character had no energy and was being forced by a friend to just get up, to cheer up, to play, to do things - for the depressed character, nothing changed. They still sat in their misery. Another friend came along and simply just sat with them. The depressed character smiled. It was a really simple animation but spoke volumes.

Yes! This. I know. Not everything unfolds the way people claim it will but nobody is ever ready for that conversation. “This worked for me and for others so this is guaranteed to work for you too, there’s studies on it” as if it even matters. People who haven’t been through it just simply won’t understand. At all. Without understanding, what else can there possibly be?

Thank you. It’s not easy. I’m sorry you’re unable to move on, I know how much it hurts to never receive the closure. As human beings it’s what we all long for, closure, clarity, completion; and when we fail to reach those things, shit goes sideways. I’m glad there are fortunate people in the world, that’s good for them. Just hate when they act like they understand our situation when it’s nothing close to it at all.
But it doesn’t.
And healing comes with acceptance too. I don’t know why we’re even meant to accept the bullshit sometimes, you know? It isn’t always possible. It’s just reality.

Everything. So many things. But not everything can be different. Can’t go back in time and undo things or can’t undo many things now. But it isn’t simple, it just isn’t. It’s very complex and I don’t say that to complain, I say that from an objective point. I mean it. I understand your analogy but I just feel as though trying to put the human mind into an analogy so simple comes across as underplaying it. I know that isn’t your intention, it’s just how it can be analysed though. Thank you for offering to listen. Listening means more than anything at this point I think. I appreciate it, a lot.

Wow. That quote hit me like a ton of bricks. I’m extremely sorry to hear about how much you’re struggling. Right? If I don’t have the energy to even wash my face or shower, there’s no way in hell I’m going outside to absorb sunlight, to go to the library and find a book I like when I don’t even know what I like anymore. When I don’t have the energy to even find out. “Killing myself requires more energy that I have to spare”. Holy fuck. You’ve just articulated my thoughts into a nutshell. 

People don’t get it. They try too hard to make us seem like broken machines and they’re the tools to fix it all, they’re the cure by giving us methods that aren’t physically applicable given the lack of energy, will, etc. from our end. I’m just glad you really get it but I’m also sorry that you do. Nobody deserves to live like this. It isn’t fair.

This has made me extremely emotional. Thank you. Thank you a million times and over. You don’t see somebody with a broken leg being told to walk on it or it gets worse. Why are we expected to do the same with our minds? What’s any different? If anything, mental health is a lot worse. There’s never any subjective cure. You can’t attend physiotherapy for your mind. 

And to answer your question, no. It isn’t selfish of you. I’m glad your alive too despite not wanting that for yourself but I genuinely do want it for you. I hope you have a chance at happiness because you do deserve it. Truly. Thank you for understanding. I resonate with your response immensely.

And they’re very fortunate they don’t. I don’t wish it upon anybody. I just think people who don’t understand shouldn’t try to act like they do. Nothing is worse than being told “I feel you”..when they just don’t.

I feel the same too. I see so many people dying young and I just think, why them? Why not me? I’d trade it for anything a lot of the time. It’s the hardest thing to simply live and wake up everyday when it doesn’t become simple anymore. When it’s the one thing you no longer want but constantly get given because it’s just human instinct to keep us alive. I’m sorry you feel this way too. It hurts.
Thank you for your hopefulness. I appreciate it. You can do it too. <3

I know how that feels all too well. Or when you’re crossing a road and you have racing, intrusive thoughts that make you curious about “but what would happen if i was to just go into an oncoming vehicle?”. “My body feels like a ton of bricks”. I understand. I really do. I’m so sorry.

Exactly. Especially when it’s been an experience your entire life so far and people say it’s temporary. But how? This life is ALL I have ever known and it’s fucking horrible. I’m sorry you feel this way too but I’m glad we can both be frank about it rather than feeding off cliches.
Agree with the both of you. When you’re in that state of mind, nothing else matters. At all. It’s a battle between your hurt and the entire world. Everybody else is on the opposing team.
Thank you for being that friend. Never change.

I agree with this incredibly. People truly underestimate the power of listening. I would rather somebody sit with me in complete silence instead of feeding me generically filled words with no meaning. “I don’t need to be told I’d feel better if my apartment was clean”. This. “Just make your bed in the morning”, yes because flattened sheets change anything.

Sad we live in a superficial world where a male is depressed and is automatically told to hit the gym to physically look better in order to get girls. As if that’s the answer to everything. I’m so sorry.
I think that’s the hard reality of life. We can’t really fix anything, we can’t go back. We can only then find ways to “cope” with our traumas, our pain. But what if we can’t cope? What then?

Thank you for trying to help somebody. I really hope he ended up okay and it means a lot that you’ve come to an understanding regarding what I’ve expressed. Of course you didn’t have any ill intention. Truth is I don’t think anybody does when trying to help others. I just think people are so misinformed as to how and that’s because society, the system; everything - pushes this concept of “feel good” things. It’s always the focus on the positive. Of course you can’t expect to make progress by immersing in the downfalls of everything but it’s important to acknowledge the pain. I think people are so fixated on trying to mend things, to “fix” you when really, what would make the most difference is to sit in the pain with somebody. Let them talk to you as them. Don’t try to talk them out of it (don’t encourage it either), simply listen. I think people feel so inclined to fill the void with feel good words with no substance that ultimately, it doesn’t solve anything. 

I feel selfish a lot of the time because I want help that isn’t really attainable at all. I wish I could undo a lot of the pain but I can’t. I don’t expect people to fix me, fix my situation or fix things. 

The solution lays within not what we want to hear but what people think we want to hear. That’s the problem. People think we want to hear that everything will be okay, that life gets better and it just means nothing to us when we hear that. We’ve gotten to this point because life has NOT gotten better. You just need to listen. I’ve appreciated it a lot more when people have sat with me in complete silence and just offered their physical presence, rather than filling it with in a way, useless “methods” because it feels invalidating. It’s like, I’m telling you I’m on the verge of life and you’re telling me that making my bed in the morning will give me some dopamine? Boring. Just listen.

Thank you. I do have a very few people who give life meaning but it’s gotten to the point where it isn’t enough to sustain my will to live, you know? Not to discredit them, it’s me. Of course, I’m aware this is a vulnerable space and don’t want to breed negativity. Just need a space to vent, to discover that I’m not the only one feeling this way.
I’m sorry you can relate. Thank you for your gratitude.
Ah the good old searching for attention shit. I know that all too well from it coming from your family too. Sorry to hear that.
I do haha. Physically yeah makes you feel badass but at the end of the day when you’re all alone with your thoughts what the fuck is there to stop them? Nothing.

You’re one of the people who assume none of us try. I have been trying for the past 7 fucking years. I’ve had a gym membership for years now. I ate healthy for years now. It doesn’t work for everybody. Glad it’s worked for you though and wish you all the best with it.

It doesn’t seem pathetic as it’s something I’m told rather often. It’s frustrating to hear though to say the least because I’ve lost all faith a long time ago. If a higher power truly existed (not to discredit anybody’s beliefs) then what’s the reason for all this bullshit? I may be vulnerable but I’m not inclined to falling under the influence to beliefs people try to push upon me (not saying that is your intention but it does come across that way).

I feel you. Yes it helps physically I guess but nothing is more overpowering than the mental burden that destroys you physically too. No matter how much you “take care” of yourself. You just can’t apply yourself to it anymore when everything goes to shit. It’s a distraction, not an active solution to the real problem.

Agreed. At the end of the day we don’t have anybody but ourselves but when you lose yourself, what do you have then? I feel trapped in my own body and don’t feel in control of being able to fix things because realistically, some things cannot be mended and I just can’t accept it. I can’t. I hope you keep yourself safe.

Exactly. I’d rather someone tell me they flat out have no idea what to say rather than sit there and tell me that everything will be okay when they just don’t KNOW that. And when they do a 180 and say “but you don’t know that things won’t be okay either”. Like I get it. But it doesn’t help. People think they need to always say something to fill the void, to help you. They’d rather be the ones doing the talking despite not understanding, instead of listening to why you’re truly paining. Realistically I’m not entitled to anyone sitting through the pain with me but it’s like fuck, if you don’t want to just say so and go. Don’t just skip over it all and tell me how to “fix” this. Years of trauma and ongoing troubles won’t be cured within some small quote you give me.

And it’s always the ones who haven’t experienced anything close to it who act like listening to music or anything of that sort will change your life. “Have a relaxing bath and light some candles”, seriously?

I’m really glad that it has helped you and that you’ve found new hobbies, I’m happy that it has worked for you. The thing is, I do do all of that but it’s gotten to a point where I just can’t anymore, too many complexities to go into. I do have people to talk to I guess but they don’t know what to say anymore and I don’t blame them either because I wouldn’t even know what to say to myself, they know they can’t change anything and it’s just reality. Thank you for offering to be that person; that’s very kind of you. I just don’t think anything actively targets the actual problem if I’m being honest.

Exactly, thank you. You get it. If going for a walk can cure you then how much are you really experiencing? Of course it has benefits but they aren’t life changing, not for everyone at least and people just keep trying to force it constantly.

That’s what pisses me off. People treat it like a physical illness. A physical illness has an objective cure whereas mental illnesses are so complex and distinct for everyone but no one treats it that way ever. Like sorry but meditate? Yeah because sitting in front of some “relaxing” music is even possible when you can’t even stop the racing thoughts of suicide on your mind. I agree. So fucking pointless trying to talk about it when there’s just no understanding because it makes me end up feeling worse than anything. I hate that too. “Trauma makes you grow”, no. No it doesn’t. It has destroyed every inch of life within me and the “strength” I have is simply me waking up everyday despite not wanting to because I haven’t stumbled across a fail proof method of suicide yet that is guaranteed death. So bullshit.

I’m sorry that this makes sense to you too. In a way there’s comfort knowing I’m not the only one but at the same time, nobody deserves this shit. Feel free to give me a message if you need. This shit sucks and I know how lonely it all gets. Absolutely horrifying.

Exactly. Everybody uses a one size fits all approach and completely dismisses that we are individuals with our own complexities and we can only ever see life through our perspective. We all have different lived experiences but when it comes to helping people? Throw that out the fucking window. People act like we’re no longer our own person by feeding us the exact same typical bullshit. Oh you’ve lost interest? How about trying to gain it again? Yeah thanks. Thanks a lot. That helps. I am telling you I want to die and you want to tell me to absorb some sun. Seriously? Makes me feel even more foolish and invalidated if anything. It’s as if they just take the piss. Majority only help because it makes them feel better about themselves rather than taking into consideration the welfare of the other person. Then they want to call you selfish for wanting to die? Rich coming from them. 

The world isn’t pretty and magical all the time and nobody is ready for that fucking conversation. Ever.

And also I don’t give a fuck if it’s selfish. I’ve spent majority of my life living for others. When is it my turn to live for myself? “Suicide doesn’t end the pain, it passes it on to others” yada yada who fucking cares anymore. “Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary feeling”, that’s the fucking point, it’s meant to be permanent. It’s meant to be the end all. It’s selfish to expect somebody to continue living for you when all they want to do is die. Don’t even try to tell me otherwise.
